hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was toggled from off to on at 13:47, and the newly-enabled code path divides by zero on the account page, turning ~1-2% background errors into a sustained ~27-35% error rate.

supporting_evidence.claim: INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations (every minute 13:40 through 13:46)
ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero (first appears exactly at the onset minute, replacing the prior UpstreamTimeout errors)
INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=on - 200 evaluations (all subsequent minutes)
error_rate jumps from 0.015 to 0.335 at the same minute the flag flips
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-05T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-12T13:52:04Z: (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Alternative: a latent defect in already-deployed code was merely exposed by the flag ramp rather than caused by it - i.e. the account-page spend calculation cannot handle a zero denominator for some accounts. No deploy exists in the change record to blame, so this remains a code-defect story with the flag as trigger.
